question: Which of the following types of piston rings is placed on the top of the piston in an IC engine?
solution:
The correct answer is __Compression ring.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Compression ring__ is positioned on the top of the piston in an internal combustion (IC) engine.
 
• It is responsible for sealing the combustion chamber to prevent leakage of gases during the power stroke.
 
• These rings are designed to withstand high pressure and temperature in the combustion process.
 
• The compression ring also assists in transferring heat from the piston to the cylinder wall.
 
• They play a key role in ensuring optimal engine efficiency and performance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Oil ring:**

 
 
• The oil ring is used to control the lubrication of the cylinder walls by scraping off excess oil.
 
• It prevents the oil from entering the combustion chamber.
 
 
 
• **Pressure ring:**
 
 
• Primarily helps in distributing pressure evenly on the piston head.
 
• It supports the compression ring by maintaining proper sealing.
 
 
 
• **Wiper ring:**
 
 
• The wiper ring aids in cleaning excess oil from the cylinder walls before combustion.
 
• It acts as a secondary seal to support the compression ring.
